name: kq-app-create-played-at
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {track_external_id: (required) external_id of the existing Track, venue_external_id: (required) external_id of the existing Venue}. Auth: X-IK-ClientKey only (_Application subject), no Bearer token, $_appId is auto-filled. Returns: the new PLAYED_AT relationship plus the Track and Venue external_ids.
